prompt: You control a real simulated XYZ yaw gantry with a parallel gripper. No tools. Use the image(s) and telemetry, not internal state. Image resolution 480x360. Pixel (0,0) is top left. Millimetres; world +X is right, +Y away from camera. Positive yaw is counterclockwise from above. Fixed brass pins are on a dark base. Movable gray plate has two holes. Jaws grasp across its short sides. Output exactly one JSON object. Insertion command height 7.3 mm; measured wrist height 7.31 mm; following-error alarm False. Decide release/open jaws or retract and retry with a relative correction bounded to 15 mm, 25 degrees. Return {"op":"release"} or {"op":"retry","dx":mm,"dy":mm,"dyaw":degrees}. Remaining permitted retries: 1.
